issue.description:
AGENTS.md states two binding rules: 'Never claim compatibility without passing the corresponding conformance suite' and 'NEEDLE compatibility is defined by research/specs/needle-cli-contract-v1.md'. The visible conformance suites are all feature-scoped (attempt-resolution, claim-epoch, redaction, unknown-field round trips) and the only NEEDLE-facing coverage is the claim-epoch consumer canary (beadrs-41b9130e); nothing asserts the cross-cutting contract-v1 surface itself. Work: derive a conformance suite from the spec's behavioral assertions — command surface, exit codes and structured-error conventions, output shapes, and the `.beads/issues.jsonl` interchange-checkpoint expectations — using value-free fixtures authored in this repo; wire it into the standard verification gate (scripts/definition-of-done.sh) so a compatibility claim cannot land without it; record in the bead which spec clauses map to which test and any clause deliberately not automated. No source or prose from any other bead implementation may be consulted (clean-room boundary).

---
Priority: P2
Created by: weave strand
issue.title: Add a needle-cli-contract-v1 conformance suite gating NEEDLE compatibility claims
